WEBHOOK.DESCRICAO_DICA: A short sentence, so whoever reads the history knows what was sent. E.g.: Send to the billing system.
WEBHOOK.URL_DICA: Ask whoever runs the other system for this address. It starts with https://.
WEBHOOK.URL_INVALIDA: The address must start with https://.
WEBHOOK.CORPO_DICA: Each line carries one piece of information: the name the other system expects and the customer data that goes in it.
WEBHOOK.CORPO_NOME: Name of the information (as the other system calls it)
WEBHOOK.CORPO_NOME_REPETIDO: There is already a line with this name.
WEBHOOK.CORPO_NOVA: Send one more piece of information
WEBHOOK.GRAVAR_DICA: If the other system returns a number or a code, keep it in a field to use later. It also works when it refuses: keep the reason to alert the team.
WEBHOOK.GRAVAR_SEM_CAMPO: To keep the answer, first create a custom field on the card, contact or conversation.
WEBHOOK.GRAVAR_CHAVE: Name of the information in the answer
WEBHOOK.GRAVAR_NOVO: Keep one more piece of information

SEGREDO.DICA: The other system uses this secret to check that the sending really came from this automation. Give it to whoever runs it.
SEGREDO.SO_ADMIN: Only the account administrator sees and changes the secret.
SEGREDO.SALVAR_ANTES: Save the automation to see the secret.
SEGREDO.CONFIRMAR: The current secret stops working right away. The other system needs the new one. Change it?
SEGREDO.TROCAR_FALHOU: We could not confirm the change. The old secret may no longer work: view the secret again.
SEGREDO.FALHOU: Could not get the secret now. Try again.
